arms.conditional_current: identical current KB; public and causal local evidence admit only clauses with latency_ms > landmark_ms
arms.unconditional_current: current raw exact/prefix hard-backoff; public and causal local evidence admit all eligible clauses

causal_replay: manifest task order; both arms predict every task clause before any task observation settles
decision_rule: target/landmark GO only if conditional accuracy is strictly above unconditional current and same-survivor majority in both cohorts
folding: five deterministic sha256(repository)-ordered round-robin folds per cohort; validation repositories excluded from public fit
prediction_launch: t=0 for every clause in both arms
target_limit: latency uses canonical total-duration buckets and resources use whole-clause aggregates; these are not future-after-landmark targets
